qa.title: Q1686 (Nov. 14, 2025)
qa.question: If I have 9 cards or fewer in my deck when I play this follower's Fanfare ability, do I lose the game?
qa.answer: No. You would simply banish as many cards as possible, then resolve the rest of the ability. You would only lose if you must draw a card when there are none remaining in your deck.

qa.title: Q1726 (Nov. 14, 2025)
qa.question: I have 2 copies of this follower on my field. If I choose option 1 when resolving the automatic ability of one copy, can I choose option 1 when resolving the automatic ability of the other copy in the same turn?
qa.answer: Yes, you can. The "choose one that you haven't chosen this turn" restriction only applies to that individual copy.

qa.title: Q1725 (Nov. 14, 2025)
qa.question: What counts toward "the number of times your leader has lost defense this turn"?
qa.answer: Any time your leader takes damage, is given -X defense, or has its defense changed to a lower value counts. For example, paying the cost of Zealot of Lust's activated ability.

qa.title: Q1724 (Nov. 14, 2025)
qa.question: If I can't select an enemy follower on the field, can I still choose option 1 to have nothing happen?
qa.answer: No. If you can't select an enemy follower, you would be required to choose option 2 or 3.
